lede: Wat Tun Klang accounts for 22 catalogued manuscripts, 10 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phayao (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (50%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (50%). Dated witnesses run 1758–1948 CE (7 of 22 carry a date).
